text: dsh-idle-compact 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的会话压缩插件。它在用户等待期间启动计时；满足空闲、正常完成、无后台任务且上下文达到阈值等条件时，先在会话副本上准备 DSH /compact 的摘要，不改变当前会话。页面会在输入框上方显示压缩提示，用户可点击按钮应用准备好的结果。插件还提供上下文 token 阈值和空闲秒数设置，适合希望在长会话空闲时提前准备压缩、回来后再决定是否应用的用户。需要 DSH Web UI；没有插件自有 API 密钥配置。

dsh-idle-compact is a DSH Web plugin that prepares /compact summaries while a session is idle. It checks turn status, background work and context threshold, then stores a summary made on a session copy. Users can review its history count and apply it from a bar above the input.
长会话闲置一会儿后，能不能先准备好压缩让我回来再应用？
想根据上下文长度和空闲时间自动准备 DSH 会话压缩。
Can DSH prepare a long conversation summary while I am away and let me apply it later?
dsh-idle-compact 的功能「空闲时预备压缩」：用户等待超过设定时长且会话符合完成状态、无后台任务和上下文阈值条件时，插件在会话副本上生成并暂存压缩结果，不改动当前对话。
dsh-idle-compact 的功能「点击应用已准备压缩」：DSH Web 输入框上方显示摘要覆盖的历史条数和 token 数；点击应用后执行 DSH 的 /compact 命令，并重放准备阶段记录的相同摘要请求结果。
dsh-idle-compact 在空闲期间会调用当前配置的模型生成压缩摘要；即使用户不回来应用，准备摘要时的模型调用也已发生。
dsh-idle-compact 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 24 天；提交数 9；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-idle-compact README · dsh-idle-compact [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that prepares a compaction of a long session while you are away, before the model provider's KV cache expires, and lets you apply it with one click when you come back.

dsh-idle-compact README · Why：Providers cache the prompt prefix of a conversation for a few minutes. While the cache is warm, re-reading a long history is cheap. Once it expires, your next message re-bills the whole history at the full, uncached input price.

If you walk away from a long session, this plugin produces the compaction summary while the cache is still warm, so that summarization request is cheap. Nothing changes in your session until you decide to apply it.

dsh-idle-compact README · How it works：1. When a session finishes a turn and waits for you, a timer starts.
2. Any new activity in that session cancels the timer, whether it's you replying or the agent starting work.
3. When the timer fires, the plugin prepares a compaction only if all of these hold:
   - the agent is still idle and its last turn finished normally (not an error or a stop);
   - no background job or subagent is running for the session;
   - the session's context, measured with DSH's token meter, has reached the threshold.
4. Preparing runs exactly the summarization request DSH's `/compact` would make, and keeps the result. Your session is not changed.
5. An **Apply compaction** bar appears just above the message input, showing how many history items it covers.
6. Clicking it runs DSH's own `/compact` command, exactly as if you had typed it, and answers its summarization request with the prepared result, so no new model call is made. The conversation shows the usual `/compact` card with its "Compacted N history items" reply.

dsh-idle-compact README · How it works：The prepared summary is only valid for the conversation it summarized. If you send another message (or the history changes in any other way), it is discarded and the button disappears; the next idle period that qualifies prepares a fresh one. If the conversation somehow differs at the moment you click, `/compact` makes its own model call instead of using a stale summary.

dsh-idle-compact README · How it works：When the plugin starts or is reloaded (a DSH restart, a plugin update), sessions that are already waiting are timed from the end of their last turn. A session idle for less than the idle delay is timed for only the remaining seconds. A session idle for longer is skipped entirely, because the provider's cache has most likely expired and preparing would cost full price. It qualifies again after its next turn.
dsh-idle-compact README · How it works：Subagent sessions are skipped, because they never wait for a user reply. If the agent is busy when the timer fires, nothing is prepared and this is logged.

dsh-idle-compact README · Settings：Open **Plugins → Idle Compact** in the DSH Web UI:

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Context length threshold (tokens) | `256000` | Prepare a compaction only when the session context has reached this length. |
| Idle time (seconds) | `300` (5 min) | How long you must go without replying before a compaction is prepared. |

Both fields take whole numbers of at least 1. Changes apply without a restart. A changed idle time takes effect the next time a session starts waiting.

dsh-idle-compact README · Settings：You can also set them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: idle-compact
  config:
    contextThresholdTokens: 200000
    idleSeconds: 240

dsh-idle-compact README · Install：Requires the DSH Web UI. Tested on DSH 0.2.1-alpha.3 and 0.2.1-rc.2; earlier versions are untested. The plugin uses DSH's authenticated `/api` routes, its settings-form components, and the area above the message input (`conversation.input.dock`).

```sh
dsh plugin add github:Arrosam/dsh-idle-compact
```

Or, in the Web UI, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter `github:Arrosam/dsh-idle-compact` or a local checkout path.

dsh-idle-compact README · Token cost：Each prepared compaction makes one summarization call to your model. It's cheap because the cache is warm, but it is spent even if you never click Apply or never return to that session. If most of your idle sessions are ones you abandon, raise the threshold.

Prepared summaries are kept in memory only. Restarting DSH discards them.

dsh-idle-compact README · Page endpoints：The browser half talks to the Host over two routes on DSH's own `/api` channel. DSH checks the browser's login and origin before either route runs, so other programs and other websites can't use them.

dsh-idle-compact README · Page endpoints：- `GET /api/idle-compact/events?sessionId=<id>`: a server-sent event stream. The first message is the session's current state, and another follows each change. Each message is `{ "prepared": false }`, or `{ "prepared": true, "items": <history items>, "tokens": <approx. tokens>, "applying": <boolean> }`.
- `POST /api/idle-compact/apply` with JSON `{ "sessionId": "<id>" }` applies the prepared compaction. Responses:

dsh-idle-compact README · Page endpoints：| Status | Body | When |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | `{ "ok": <boolean>, "result": <command result> }` | `/compact` ran; `ok` is whether it succeeded. Its outcome also shows in the chat. |
| 200 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "command-unavailable" }` | The `/compact` command isn't available. |
| 400 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "bad-body" }` | The body isn't a JSON object with a non-empty string `sessionId`. |
| 404 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "no-session" }` | No live session has that id. |
| 409 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "not-prepared" }` | Nothing is prepared, or it went stale. |
| 409 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "applying" }` | An apply is already running for that session. |
| 500 | `{ "ok": false, "code": "failed", "message": "…" }` | Applying failed unexpectedly. |

dsh-idle-compact README · Tests：```sh
npm test
```

The tests load the plugin into a real DSH runtime from your local DSH install and fake only the model provider and the browser connection. Set `DSH_RUNTIME_DIRS` (colon-separated `node_modules/@deepseek-ai` directories) to choose which runtimes to test against.

dsh-idle-compact README · Files：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: settings schema, public exports, and wiring of the parts below. |
| `src/idle-scheduler.js` | One idle timer per agent; aborts its work when the agent resumes. |
| `src/prepare.js` | Eligibility checks, and producing the summary on a detached copy of the session. |
| `src/replay.js` | Records the summarization request while preparing; replays it once on apply. |
| `src/prepared-store.js` | What is prepared for each session, and notifying the page when it changes. |
| `src/http.js` | The page's endpoints on DSH's authenticated `/api` channel. |
| `src/constants.js`, `src/util.js` | Shared names, values, and small helpers. |
| `client.js` | Browser half: the settings form on the Plugins page and the Apply bar above the message input. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that inserts the `idle-compact` row. |
| `locale/*.json`, `icon.svg` | Display metadata for the plugin manager. |
| `test/` | Tests that run the plugin inside a real DSH runtime. |
